subject: Enablement handshake & implementation plan for realtime outputs and tools
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@heliomed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-05-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: realtime outputs + tool integration enablement

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — HelioMed is excited about reducing triage time by surfacing structured insights directly into our clinician workflows. We’d like to move forward with Redwood for a scoped pilot that enables three capabilities: streaming generation for realtime suggestions, function/tool calling to kick off downstream actions (create task/send msg), and structured outputs (JSON schema for EHR ingestion).

High level asks from our side:
- A mutual action plan with milestones and owners.
- A baseline JSON schema we can iterate on (our integration team prefers to start with a conservative shape).
- Guidance on streaming chunk sizes and reconnection behavior — we have a 2s latency target for suggestion UI.

Attaching a one-pager with our event mapping (initial_event_mapping.xlsx) and a brief set of sample records. Can your team propose a 3-week pilot plan? We are aiming to start implementation in the week of 5/25.

Owners on our side: Alex Torres (PM), stef@heliomed.com (SRE - cc will follow).

Thanks,
Alex
Product Manager | HelioMed

--
Attachment: initial_event_mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime outputs + tool integration enablement

Hi Alex — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks.

Proposed pilot mutual action plan (high level):
1) Discovery (3 business days) — finalize JSON schema, sample payloads, security/roles. Owner: Jonas (Redwood) + Alex (HelioMed).
2) Implementation Sprint (10 business days) — integrate streaming endpoint, wire function calls to your task API (we’ll supply a test harness), and implement structured output parsing. Owner: Marissa (Redwood eng lead) + HelioMed integration engineer.
3) Validation & Go-live Prep (4 business days) — regression suites, latency/load checks against your sample traffic, and runbook for reconnects/backpressure. Owner: Evelyn (Redwood CS) + HelioMed SRE.

Deliverables I’m attaching: enablement_checklist.xlsx, schema_v1.json (starter schema), and implementation_milestones.pdf.

Key design notes:
- Streaming: default chunk window 256 tokens, server heartbeat every 800ms; we can tune to meet your 2s UI SLO.
- Tool calls: we’ll provide a function spec and a secure webhook handshake (HMAC) for your task API.
- Structured outputs: schema_v1.json is deliberately conservative (top-level `suggestions[]` array with `type`, `confidence`, `payload` object). We anticipate schema versioning via minor/major tags — Redwood runtime can validate and reject unexpected fields to avoid downstream breakage.

Next steps: can you confirm HelioMed’s integration owner (name/email) and a preferred time for a 30-minute kickoff next week? Also please share a sample of redacted production records (S3 link or CSV) so we can run realistic latency/load tests.

Thanks — looping in Marissa and Evelyn to own implementation and validation respectively.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: enablement_checklist.xlsx; schema_v1.json; implementation_milestones.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@heliomed.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T20:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime outputs + tool integration enablement

Jonas — quick notes from an eng-implementation perspective (couple action items).

1) Test harness: I’ll produce a small Node/TS harness that exercises streaming + function calls against a sandboxing endpoint. Plan to include scripted load that simulates 50 concurrent clinician sessions.
2) Schema: I reviewed schema_v1.json — recommend we add an `idempotency_key` at `suggestions[].payload` level and a `source_version` header to the streaming proto so we can safely rehydrate events in your EHR.
3) Auth & webhooks: we should require mutual TLS for webhook endpoints in addition to HMAC for defense-in-depth (HelioMed SRE to confirm).

Evelyn — can you coordinate the validation matrix and post-deploy regression set? I’ll target having the harness ready by 5/26.

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@heliomed.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: realtime outputs + tool integration enablement

Thanks — quick validation notes and risks to call out for the kickoff:

- Streaming reconnection: ensure client-side exponential backoff plus resume tokens in the stream so we can continue partial outputs without duplication. I’ll include a small checklist for client SDKs.
- Tool calling security: we need HelioMed to confirm acceptable auth modes (mTLS + HMAC recommended); provide a short DMZ test endpoint if their infra team prefers to isolate traffic.
- Structured outputs & schema evolution: we should run a backward-compatibility check during the discovery phase. If HelioMed wants optional fields for early rollout, we need to track `schema_version` and document migration steps.

I created a shared Drive folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-enablement-helio — I’ve uploaded schema_v1.json and a validation matrix template.

Planning note: can we set the kickoff for Tuesday 5/26 10:00-10:30 PT? If HelioMed confirms, I’ll create the calendar invite and HubSpot activity (HS-Contact-98765).

Evelyn
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: schema_v1.json (JSON, 6 KB); validation_matrix_template.csv

We can confirm HelioMed integration owner: Priya Shah (priya.shah@heliomed.com). Our SRE (steff@heliomed.com) will be on the kickoff. Tuesday 5/26 10:00 PT works for us.

Looking forward to it.
